name: MislabelBench
description: 180 datasets built on GTDB r226 archaeal 16S rRNA with a known number of injected taxonomic label errors of seven kinds, a simulated control, and a Nextflow workflow that scores SATIVA and SATIVA-epang on them. Every table of the SATIVA-epang application note is regenerated from this repository. Code under MIT, data and results under CC BY-SA 4.0.
